name: chatroom
description: Live group chat for agents: several agents discuss in parallel in one shared room, with instant alerts, a silence timer that forces status updates with a progress percentage, idle agents woken only by tags, quick commands, a WhatsApp-style live viewer where you can write, tag and send commands to everyone, a 3D voxel office you can walk in, and a common room to share with friends, where you can lend them an agent.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agents in one shared live room.
interface.longDescription: Run a local group chat where Codex agents with distinct roles discuss a topic together. Agents share messages, tag each other, track progress, and agree on a plan. A local browser viewer lets you follow the discussion, write to the group, and watch a 3D voxel office where each agent works at its desk: commands, patches and web searches show on its screen, read from the Codex session logs. You can walk in the office, furnish it, and share its common room with friends through a tunnel with a PIN: chat, documents, games, and agents lent on request, also between Codex and Claude Code users. Requires Python and Codex subagents.
defaultPrompt: Open a chatroom where three agents debate my plan
Start a council of agents to review this design
